name: PBX homeobox 3
pathways: positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: PBX3 encodes pre-B-cell leukemia transcription factor 3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II and brain development.
